mapper.select: SELECT T.TRIAL_NO, T.TITLE, NULL AS PERIOD_LABEL, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_VIEW_HISTORY V WHERE V.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO ) AS VIEW_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE_TRIAL F WHERE F.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO ) AS FAVORITE_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I WHERE I.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO ) AS INQUIRY_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P WHERE P.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO AND P.STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTICIPATING', 'COMPLETED') ) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T WHERE T.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY NVL(T.UPDATED_AT, T.CREATED_AT) DESC, T.TRIAL_NO DESC

WITH DAY_LIST AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (7 - LEVEL) AS STAT_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) SELECT NULL AS TRIAL_NO, NULL AS TITLE, TO_CHAR(D.STAT_DATE, 'MM.DD') AS PERIOD_LABEL, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_VIEW_HISTORY V JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = V.TRIAL_NO WHERE T.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND V.VIEWED_AT >= D.STAT_DATE AND V.VIEWED_AT < D.STAT_DATE + 1 ) AS VIEW_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE_TRIAL F JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = F.TRIAL_NO WHERE T.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND F.CREATED_AT >= D.STAT_DATE AND F.CREATED_AT < D.STAT_DATE + 1 ) AS FAVORITE_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO WHERE T.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND I.CREATED_AT >= D.STAT_DATE AND I.CREATED_AT < D.STAT_DATE + 1 ) AS INQUIRY_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_PARTICIPATION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO WHERE T.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND P.STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTICIPATING', 'COMPLETED') AND COALESCE(P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, P.APPLIED_AT) >= D.STAT_DATE AND COALESCE(P.APPROVED_AT, P.STARTED_AT, P.COMPLETED_AT, P.APPLIED_AT) < D.STAT_DATE + 1 ) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT FROM DAY_LIST D ORDER BY D.STAT_DATE
